oracle: import Ajv from "ajv/dist/2020";import{Database}from"bun:sqlite";const plan=JSON.parse(process.argv[1]),schema=JSON.parse(process.argv[2]),sample=JSON.parse(process.argv[3]);const validate=new Ajv({strict:true}).compile(schema);if(!validate(plan)||validate({...plan,unknown:true}))throw Error("closed semantic corpus");const db=Database.deserialize(new Uint8Array(await Bun.stdin.arrayBuffer())),quote=v=>'"'+v.replaceAll('"','""')+'"';try{if(db.query("PRAGMA integrity_check").get().integrity_check!=="ok"||db.query("PRAGMA foreign_key_check").all().length)throw Error("independent SQL integrity");let rows=0,bytes=0;for(const[table,width]of Object.entries(plan.tableWidths)){const fields=db.query("PRAGMA table_info("+quote(table)+")").all().map(v=>v.name);if(fields.length!==width)throw Error("authored columns "+table);const cells=fields.map(v=>{const f=quote(v);return "CASE typeof("+f+") WHEN 'integer' THEN 8 WHEN 'real' THEN 8 WHEN 'text' THEN length(CAST("+f+" AS BLOB)) WHEN 'blob' THEN length("+f+") ELSE 0 END";}).join("+");const extent=db.query("SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows,COALESCE(SUM("+cells+"),0) AS bytes FROM "+quote(table)).get();rows+=extent.rows;bytes+=extent.bytes;}if(rows!==sample.rows||bytes!==sample.bytes)throw Error("independent complete cells "+JSON.stringify({rows,bytes,expected:sample}));}finally{db.close();}
